caption: The drawing features a curved botanical arrangement composed of a flowering vine with elongated strands of small, white, bell-shaped or clustered flowers and several green leaves. The flowers have yellow centers and some petal highlights in pale purple. The stems and branches are slender and brown, with occasional yellow-green highlights at the joints. A few of the leaves are colored darker green while others are lighter or have yellow-green tones, displaying different stages of growth or possibly different lighting. There are also unopened buds interspersed among the flowers and leaves. In the upper right corner, there is a faint line drawing of a head topped with a floral wreath resembling the main botanical arrangement, giving a suggested use of the floral strand as a headpiece or garland. The background of the image is a plain, beige color with no additional objects or patterns.
title: Bridal Wreath
